versions.changelog: Madame Dubois persona, Roast My French mode, placement test, progress tracking, false friends, streak milestones, shareable result cards

v2.1.0: Zero-config quick start (value in 10 seconds), Daily French micro-lesson mode (mot du jour + 60-second challenge), Survival French travel phrasebook (airport, restaurant, hotel, emergencies, directions), session wrap-up with progress highlights and next-step suggestions, slash-command invocable with argument hints, SEO-optimized description for ClawHub discovery.

Extended from beginner-only (A1-A2) to full A1 through B2+ coverage. Added level assessment, intermediate/advanced grammar (subjunctive, conditional, literary tenses), and new exercise types: opinion & debate, error spotting, register switching, and free conversation.
Initial release — interactive beginner French tutor
